# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure oauth-sign-in from .claude/orrery/plan.json (decisions.md 2026-10-22 applied). # Happy path only. Left out on purpose: refresh rotation and logout revocation (session-lifecycle), # the version-1 restart bridge GET /api/auth/oauth/v2/{provider}/restart (HTTP 303, an upgrade path # for old PWA shells that ends in step 1), error branches (cancelled, expired, already used, # 409 missing verifier, 502 provider outage), the PKCE-client guard and 20/minute rate limits # (checks inside step 8), and prefetch after sign-in (session-lifecycle). # Every edge carries step: so `render -f sequence.svg` draws the lifelines in step order. title: OAuth sign-in with S256 PKCE and signed one-use state subtitle: "Happy path in 16 steps: the signed 10-minute state is recorded in audit_logs and consumed once before the provider exchange" direction: right layout: { spacing: compact }
legend: solid: Request dashed: Response or redirect back

svg.title: OAuth sign-in with S256 PKCE and signed one-use state
svg.desc: OAuth sign-in with S256 PKCE and signed one-use state. 7 components in 4 groups. Connections: SPA auth service to OAuth router (POST authorize + challenge); OAuth router to audit_logs (record pending attempt); SPA auth service to OAuth router (signed state, 10 min); SPA auth service to sessionStorage attempt (keep verifier); SPA auth service to Google or GitHub (redirect with challenge); SPA auth service to Google or GitHub (callback with code, state); SPA auth service to sessionStorage attempt (consume attempt); SPA auth service to OAuth router (POST callback + verifier); OAuth router to audit_logs (check signature + S256 verifier, consume once); OAuth router to Google or GitHub (exchange code + verifier); OAuth router to Google or GitHub (fetch profile (subject) and verified email); OAuth router to users (match or create user by subject); OAuth router to audit_logs (record refresh JTI, sign JWTs); SPA auth service to OAuth router (access + refresh tokens); SPA auth service to OAuth router (GET /api/auth/me); SPA auth service to Auth store (install user + tokens).

text.tspan: OAUTH SIGN-IN WITH S256 PKCE AND SIGNED ONE-USE STATE
Happy path in 16 steps: the signed 10-minute state is recorded in audit_logs and consumed once before the provider exchange
